map.📖 查看「养殖废水 COD 估算使用指南」: 📖 View the "Aquaculture Effluent COD Estimation Guide"
map.每千克饲料约产生 0.3-0.4 kg COD（残饵+粪便，可按系数调整）；CO: Each kilogram of feed produces about 0.3-0.4 kg of COD (uneaten feed + faeces, adjustable by coefficient); COD load = feed amount × COD coefficient; concentration = load ÷ discharge volume. Compare with standards such as the Requirements for Water Discharge from Freshwater Pond Aquaculture (COD limit about 30 mg/L) to assess compliance.

map.日投饵 50 kg（COD 产生系数 0.35）→ COD 负荷 17.5 kg: A daily feed amount of 50 kg (COD generation coefficient 0.35) gives a COD load of 17.5 kg/day; a discharge of 200 m³/day gives an estimated COD of 87.5 mg/L, 2.92 times the 30 mg/L standard, requiring treatment or about 383 m³ of extra dilution water to comply.
map.养殖废水 COD 标准多少？: What is the COD standard for aquaculture effluent?
map.常见淡水养殖排放要求 COD 不超过 30 mg/L（一级），具体以当地排放标准: Common freshwater aquaculture discharge requirements set COD at no more than 30 mg/L (Grade I), subject to the local discharge standard; exceeding it requires treatment or dilution before discharge.
map.源头减料控残饵、增设沉淀/生态塘/曝气生物处理，或尾水循环；关键在减少饲料残留与: Reduce feed at source to control leftovers, add sedimentation/ecological ponds/aerated biological treatment, or recirculate the tail water; the key is less feed residue and better water exchange.
